rationale: The sibling connectDataSourcePopup.spec.js already asserts [data-test="community-slack-invite-dialog"] count 0, but only as a secondary line inside expectBothDialogsAbsent() coupled to the ConnectDataSourcePopup. The run-context (needs_e2e: true, spec_filename communitySlackInvite.spec.js) and the feature doc both call for a dedicated spec for this distinct component's dismiss/snooze change. The new spec stays focused on the Slack invite only (slack-only assertion, not the connect popup) and is the documented home for the Cloud snooze tests that cannot run on OSS. It needs registration in ci_matrix.json GeneralTests.run_files.
